source.source_name: Shopify Global Catalog extension: external offer display and usage requirements
source.purpose: Prevent unsafe reuse of external offers in video_shopify merchandising, content, and model training
source.cost_quota: free public official docs; no credential or paid credit
source.reliability_limits: Beta, source restrictions and enabled-client requirements may change; docs do not establish that this workspace has Catalog API access or uses external offers. External prices and stock must be rechecked on the merchant site.

learning.title: Shopify external offers: seller links, no rehosting/training, and indicative price or stock
learning.claim: Shopify Global Catalog extension documentation (checked 2026-10-28) says external offers are display-only, not Shopify checkout inventory: each offer must visibly identify seller.name and link to variants[].url; external product images may not be rehosted, cropped, overlaid or altered, and external offer data may not be bulk-exported, redistributed, used to train/evaluate machine-learning models or retained beyond the current shopper session. External price is indicative, and availability.available=true does not prove current stock. catalog.sources requires version 2026-08-25 or draft and an enabled client; otherwise search_catalog ignores requested sources.
learning.decision: SHOPIFY_EXTERNAL_OFFER_DISPLAY_RIGHTS_GATE: REVIEW_ONLY until the actual video_shopify consumer uses authorized Global Catalog external offers. If it does, display seller.name and link each offer to variants[].url, distinguish external from Shopify sellers, never route to Shopify checkout, never rehost/edit external images, bulk-export/redistribute offers, train/evaluate models on them, or retain them beyond the current shopper session. Do not treat indicative prices or available=true as verified stock; confirm on merchant site. Require enabled client and version 2026-08-25/draft before relying on catalog.sources. No live store or content publication.
learning.next_measurement: 2026-10-28 GitHub main code search for search_catalog, discover.shopifyapps.com/global and catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp returned zero matching code files; recheck full consumer inventory before 2026-11-02. If a consumer is found, write a negative/positive decision test and record applied_learning_ids in the actual manifest; otherwise keep REVIEW_ONLY.
fallback_history: Existing PR #368 covers US-only, checkout and commission constraints; this additive learning separately covers official display/license/retention and data-quality requirements. No existing canonical source or matching claim was found on main.
